info.title: ProxCenter public API
info.description: API for external tooling, authenticated by a pxc_ service-account token. Reading and writing depend on the scopes granted to the token. Write operations act on the real infrastructure immediately. Server to server: no CORS header is emitted.

bearerAuth.description: Send the full secret as `Authorization: Bearer pxc_...`.

get.summary: List all VMs and containers across visible connections
get.description:
Aggregated VM/LXC list with status, usage and config-derived fields (cpuType, scsihw, agentEnabled, bios, ostype, machine, createdAt, onboot, description, macs) served by default. `ips` merges the addresses pinned in the config with the last known guest agent / LXC addresses from a background index; `staleIps` lists the last known addresses a guest could not re-confirm (stopped, agent down) and `ipIndexWarming` tells that the index is still being built. Pass include=agent to probe the QEMU guest agent on running VMs (about 7x slower): agentResponding, agentVersion, agentOsName.

Required scope: `vms:read`

post.summary: Create a VM or a container
post.description:
Creates a QEMU VM ({type} = qemu) or an LXC container ({type} = lxc) on {node}. The body is the Proxmox create parameter set, forwarded once the vDC rules have run: a vDC tenant gets its pool, CPU policy, storage, network and quota enforced, and an IPAM address injected on managed bridges. Setting a NIC MAC or VLAN as a vDC tenant also needs vm.config.nic.mac / vm.config.nic.vlan, which no scope grants.

Required scope: `vms:write`
